xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DisclosureOfNotesOnComposition:
The composition of the Board of the Bank is constituted in terms of the provisions of the Banking Companies (Acquisition and Transfer of Undertakings) Act 1970. All the Directors on the Board of the Bank except Shareholder Director are nominated/appointed by Department of Financial Services, MOF, GOI. Since the public shareholding of the Bank is less than 16%, bank is permitted to elect only one director from amongst the shareholders other than Central Government. Ms. Rachna Khare elected as Shareholder Director of the Bank w.e.f. 10.01.2025, thereby fulfilling the requirement of atleast one women independent Director on the Board as per SEBI Listing Regulations.
On the Filing of this Report, GOI had nominated two Independent Directors viz. Shri Ravi Kumar Agrawal and Shri Anjan Talukdar on April 11, 2025.

xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DisclosureOfNotesOnComposition:
Audit Committee of the Board (ACB)
ACB is constituted as per BRI circular ref. DOR.GOV.REC.8/29.67.001/2021-22 dated April 26, 2021. Due to inadequacy of directors as on 31.03.2025, the requirement of "two third directors should be independent Director" could not be met.
Nomination and Remuneration Committee of Board (NRCB) -
NRCB is constituted as per GOI guidelines and RBI Circular dated August 2, 2019. As on 31.03.2025, the Position of Chairperson of NRCB is vacant due to inadequacy of directors on the Board of the Bank. RBI circular ref. DOR.GOV.REC.8/29.67.001/2021-22 dated April 26, 2021 states that -
1. The Chaiperson ofBoard shall not chair NRC. Hence, Mr. Aravamudan Krishna Kumar could not be designated as Chairperson of NRC.
2.The Chairperson of ACB and RMCB shall not chair any other committee of the Board. Hence, Ms Rachna Khare (ACB Chairperson) and Mr. Subhash Shankar Malik (RMCB Chairperson) could not be designated as chairperson of NRC.
3.NRC shall be chaired by Independent Director. Hence, Mr. Sudhir Shyam could not be designated as chairperson of NRC.
Stakeholders Relationship Committee of Board(SRC) -
As on 31.03.2025, the Position of Chairperson of SRC is vacant due to indequacy of directors on the Board of the Bank. As per RBI circular ref. DOR.GOV.REC.8/29.67.001/2021-22 dated April 26,2021, the Chairperson of ACB (Ms Rachna Khare), shall not chair any other committee of the Board. Further, as per Listing Regulations, SRC shall be chaired by Non-Executive Director. Therefore, none of the members of SRC could be appointed as Chairperson of SRC.
We would like to mention that two directors i.e. Mr. Ravi Kumar Agrawal and Mr. Anjan Talikdar are appointed by Government of India on 11-04-2025. Both are treated as Independent Directors. Hence, the vacant chairperson position of NRCB and SRC and two third of ID requirement will be satisfied.
